name: authority-scope-inventory
objective: Pin one current Captain-only execution graph and make stale, unrelated, duplicate or unresolved in-scope work impossible to hide before product writes.
truthOwner: Current task and governance/Product Truth define scope; Identity/Workforce own access/profile truth, DSH owns Captain operational truth, WLT owns financial truth.

tasks.objective: Re-pin and strictly validate the current Captain impact graph
tasks.currentProblem: The prior package is 310 product/implementation commits behind the diagnosis baseline; BB then moved one additional disjoint planning-only commit that must be preserved without invalidating Captain product diagnosis.
tasks.requiredChange: Run strict package validation, re-resolve BB before the first product write, reconcile any movement against the latest observed remote head and classify only direct Captain dependencies from current authority/Product Truth/source.
tasks.targetState: Every later unit operates from one current candidate and one evidence-backed Captain graph with no stale branch, ownership or required-surface assumption, while concurrent unrelated work remains intact.
tasks.action: Run strict validation; resolve BB; compare current head with latest observed remote SHA; classify delta as disjoint, related, overlap, conflict or authority change; update this same package before proceeding when related; never reset/force concurrent work.
mustNotChange: Do not create another Captain package.
Do not modify product/runtime/governance code in U001.
Do not treat plans or architecture output as Product Truth.
Do not overwrite or omit the disjoint field-3 concurrent package.
Do not continue from a newly moved branch until related delta is reconciled.
acceptanceCriteria: Strict package validation passes on the bookkeeping candidate.
Every related coverage entry has a current evidence reference and unit backlink.
Every exclusion has an evidence-backed reason and reopen trigger.
The disjoint field-3 subtree remains unchanged in the final commit tree.
No known Captain-related finding is left unmapped to U002-U006 or explicitly classified outside execution scope.
tasks.rollback: Revert only the package bookkeeping commit and retain all concurrent product/planning changes; never reset or force newer branch history.
tasks.commitBoundary: One package-only bookkeeping commit; no product code is allowed in this unit commit.

tasks.objective: Enforce fail-closed scope and cleanup discipline for all later units
tasks.currentProblem: Shared DSH/WLT code can cause accidental scope bleed, while a minimal-change mindset can leave known duplicate, stale or dead Captain paths behind.
tasks.requiredChange: Before every later write require a RELATED coverage mapping and truth owner; after each fix enumerate affected consumers and remove proven obsolete Captain behavior instead of retaining unjustified compatibility layers.
tasks.targetState: Later units modify every necessary in-scope dependency and no unrelated domain, while known in-scope dead/duplicate/stale behavior is a closure blocker rather than deferred debt.
tasks.action: For each proposed write map path, owner, callers and readbacks; reject proximity-only expansion; after implementation re-run caller/route/dependency census and cleanup guards, then keep the unit OPEN if any known fixable in-scope defect remains.
mustNotChange: Do not import app-field behavior because a finance component is generic.
Do not pull client-owned/catalog/marketing/dashboard work into Captain scope without proof.
Do not preserve a proven obsolete Captain path solely to minimize the diff.
Do not declare a unit done while one known fixable in-scope defect remains.
acceptanceCriteria: Every later write maps to a RELATED coverage entry before staging.
Shared changes verify every actual affected consumer without importing unrelated product work.
Proven dead, duplicate, obsolete or contradictory Captain paths are removed or canonically delegated.
Final closure has zero known fixable in-scope findings.
tasks.rollback: Revert only an invalid package/scope bookkeeping change and restore the last evidence-backed Captain boundary.
tasks.commitBoundary: Scope bookkeeping remains separate from product implementation commits.
